Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 3, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results. The WebSurfer's initial search for "Niyoti film release date" clearly showed in the viewport that the film was released in West Bengal, India on June 10, 2016. The Planner ignored this valid, earlier release date in the film's primary market (India) and instead fixated on the later Bangladesh release date (August 12, 2016) as the definitive date. This error in judgment led the Planner to establish a false premise that Niyoti was released later than Angali Pangali, causing the subsequent analysis to conclude incorrectly that Angali Pangali came out earlier, despite both films having Indian release dates in June 2016 (Niyoti on June 10, Angali Pangali on June 17).
